Hi Tessa,

Quick one — we're doing a hard launch for EdgeView next Friday (June 18) with a planned marketing push that could multiply inference traffic for ~48 hours. We expect a steady baseline but are worried about a 2–3x spike for short windows (peaks of ~3M tokens/day).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short-term headroom option (48–72 hours) that avoids punitive overrun charges? Ideally something that looks like a temporary quota lift or soft-cap so we don't get hit with sticker overage rates.
- If we need to accept uplifted rates, can you give us a price estimate and any one-time concessions (credits/discounts) so we can align procurement? We need numbers by EOD Monday to confirm our PO.

Procurement wants any commercial terms documented (addendum + PO). Happy to sign quickly if we can get a sensible guardrail.

Appreciate any options you can propose — happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Samir

Samir — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. We have three pragmatic ways to handle short-window spikes; I summarized options below with what we recommend for predictable billing and low operational risk. See attached a draft addendum and a rough invoice estimate.

Options (high-level):
A) Temporary Burst Add-on (recommended)
   - 2x quota for 7 days (start date configurable)
   - Soft-guard: first 1M uplift tokens covered by a promo credit; any additional uplift billed at uplifted rate (detailed in addendum)
   - One-time administration fee to secure headroom
B) Minute-level Headroom (pay-as-you-go)
   - No commit; elevated per-token rate for the window; automatic rollback
   - Useful if volume is unpredictable but typically more expensive than A
C) Emergency Burst Credit (short-term loan)
   - We front a portion of uplift costs as a credit; reconcile post-launch and invoice any net overrun

Prelim commercial we can offer (EdgeView):
- Recommended: Option A, 2x quota for 7 days, promo credit covering first 1,000,000 uplift tokens, then uplift charge at +18% of published rate.
- One-time admin fee: $1,500 (waivable with PO + legal sign-off)
- If you sign the addendum and PO by EOD Monday we'll extend a 15% one-time discount on uplift charges.

Looping in Ben (revenue ops) and Lauren (legal/procurement support) to confirm if we can adjust the promo credit or admin fee.

I attached a draft addendum you can share with procurement. If you'd like I can get a DocuSign ready today.

Best,
Tessa Morgan

Redwood Inference

- We should keep the uplift window to 7 days max and hard-limit the uplift multiplier to 2x to avoid capacity churn.
- We can flex the promo credit to 1.25M tokens for strategic customers but that should be tied to an executed PO and signed addendum before the start date.
- Discount: 15% is doable as a one-time concession, but only if procurement commits to a PO and we capture the HubSpot deal.
- Admin fee can be waived if finance gets the PO and legal signs off on expedited addendum.

Operational guardrail: set a hard cap at 5,000,000 uplift tokens for the 7-day window; anything beyond requires manual approval from infra and will be billed at full overrun rate.
